problem: A user question/suggestion was inferred as endorsement and immediately turned into a PR-first implementation branch even though the user had asked for an independent recommendation, demonstrating recurrence of premature solution canonicalization despite existing cold-path policy.

The prior HIGH label on main being unprotected used a multi-writer threat model that did not match the configured SINGLE_ACTIVE_CHAT writer model. The useful integrity control for this architecture is current-head/lease verification plus HEAD-level compare-and-swap, not mandatory PR-first workflow.
root_cause: Candidate-vs-authority semantics existed in SYSTEM_MAINTENANCE_POLICY and OWNER_ADAPTER_CONTRACT but were not explicit in the minimal hot-path ENTRYPOINT, allowing conversational agreement pressure to bypass independent assessment before action.

Direct-main safety had been discussed in terms of branch protection instead of distinguishing compliant single-writer mutation integrity from protection against an intentionally noncompliant authorized writer.

system_impact_map.business_owners: NO BUSINESS LEASE OR BUSINESS TRUTH MUTATION

alternatives.reason: Existing cold-path candidate semantics did not prevent the just-observed recurrence.
Adds branch/PR/merge lifecycle cost and addresses a multi-writer threat model not established for the configured single-active-writer architecture.
Targets the observed failure while preserving main as the single engineering authority and provides optimistic concurrency at the branch head.

verified_facts: GitHub connector exposes update_ref with expected_sha and force=false
existing policy already treats user proposals as candidates
decision_frontier.open_boundary: No repository rule can physically stop an authorized noncompliant external writer from intentionally ignoring lease/CAS unless GitHub permissions/protection are changed. This is an assurance ceiling, not evidence that PR-first is required for the current single-writer model.

preconditions: reread exact authority needed for the mutation
direct_main_mutation_design.commit: build one tree and one commit whose parent is the observed current main HEAD
direct_main_mutation_design.publish: advance refs/heads/main only with force=false and expected_sha equal to the observed HEAD
direct_main_mutation_design.head_mismatch: abort; reread HEAD, lease and authority; re-evaluate; never replay a stale prepared commit
postconditions: reread authoritative task state before COMMITTED

complexity_efficiency_effect: One short hot-path invariant, one section in the existing progress/commit policy, and one focused regression file. No PR lifecycle, no new root policy, no new agent.
architecture_payoff_deletion_effect: Remove the erroneous default assumption that unprotected main alone is a HIGH defect in this single-writer model; do not promote the experimental PR-first branch into architecture.
